# pve_storage_scan_lvmthin (Data Source)

LVM-thin pools discovered by scanning from a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_storage_scan_lvmthin" "example" {
node = "pve1"
vg = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `vg` (String)

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/scan/lvmthin. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `lv` (String) The LVM Thin Pool name (LVM logical volume).
